case_title: A Raj Kumar v. State of M.P.
aggravating_circumstances: Rape of a minor, premeditated murder, brutal killing, custodial responsibility
neutral_facts: The accused, who was on visiting terms with the family of the victim, was asked to stay at the victim's house on the night of the incident. The accused consumed liquor and asked the victim to sleep separately from her siblings. Around midnight, the accused committed rape on the victim and caused grievous injuries resulting in her death. The incident was witnessed by the victim's brother, who did not raise an alarm due to fear. The accused left the scene, and the victim's family discovered her body the next morning. The prosecution registered a case under Sections 302, 376, and 450 of the IPC. The trial court convicted the accused under these sections and awarded a death sentence. The High Court affirmed the conviction and sentence.
